title: Measurements of cardiac output using invasive pulmonary artery catheter compared to determination with non-invasive capnometry and indirect calorimetry in patients after cardiac surgery
summary: Comparison of invasive cardiac output measurement using PAK versus non-invasive cardiac output determination using capnometry and indirect calorimetry

interventions.name: This study compares cardiac output calculated using the modified Fick method with cardiac output values ​​measured using the invasive thermodilution method (pulmonary artery catheter [PAC]). The cardiac output is determined using three different methods: invasively using PAC and non-invasively using

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adult patients after cardiac surgery with postoperative invasive hemodynamic monitoring using PAK
Exclusion criteria:
- Pregnancy
- Refusal of the study by next of kin or the patient
